call_millicents:
def call_millicents (s : State) (c : Call) : Nat :=
  (s.prices.lookup c.model).getD 0 * c.tokens
cost:
def cost (s : State) (key : String) : Int :=
  Int.ofNat ((2 * key_millicents s key + 1000) / 2000)
input_ok:
def input_ok (key model : String) (tokens : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (key ≠ "" ∧ model ≠ "" ∧ 0 < tokens)
key_millicents:
def key_millicents (s : State) (key : String) : Nat :=
  List.sum (List.map (fun c => call_millicents s c) (List.filter (fun c => c.key == key) s.calls))
keys_of: def keys_of (s : State) : List String := s.calls.map (fun c => c.key)
lookup_cons_ne:
theorem lookup_cons_ne (k k' : String) (t : Nat) (l : List (String × Nat)) (h : k' ≠ k) : List.lookup k' ((k, t) :: l) = List.lookup k' l := by
  simp only [List.lookup]
  split <;> simp_all
lookup_cons_self: theorem lookup_cons_self (k : String) (t : Nat) (l : List (String × Nat)) : List.lookup k ((k, t) :: l) = some t := by simp [List.lookup]
pick_best:
def pick_best (s : State) (acc : String) (l : List String) : String :=
  match l with
  | [] => acc
  | k :: ks => pick_best s (if spender_better s k acc = true then k else acc) ks
pick_best_dominates:
theorem pick_best_dominates (s : State) (acc : String) (l : List String) :
    cost s acc ≤ cost s (pick_best s acc l) ∧ ∀ j, j ∈ l → cost s j ≤ cost s (pick_best s acc l) := by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil =>
    simp only [pick_best]
    exact ⟨by omega, by simp⟩
  | cons k ks ih =>
    simp only [pick_best]
    by_cases hb : spender_better s k acc = true
    · rw [if_pos hb]
      have hge := spender_better_ge s k acc hb
      have h1 := ih k
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hj
      rcases hj with hjk | hjk
      · rw [hjk]
        exact h1.1
      · exact h1.2 j hjk
    · rw [if_neg hb]
      have h1 := ih acc
      refine ⟨h1.1, ?_⟩
      intro j hj
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hj
      rcases hj with hjk | hjk
      · rw [hjk]
        have hle := spender_better_le s k acc hb
        omega
      · exact h1.2 j hjk
pick_best_mem:
theorem pick_best_mem (s : State) (acc : String) (l : List String) :
    pick_best s acc l = acc ∨ pick_best s acc l ∈ l := by
  induction l generalizing acc with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons k ks ih =>
    simp only [pick_best]
    rcases ih (if spender_better s k acc = true then k else acc) with h | h
    · by_cases hb : spender_better s k acc = true
      · right
        rw [h, if_pos hb]
        simp
      · left
        rw [h, if_neg hb]
    · right
      simp only [List.mem_cons]
      exact Or.inr h
quota_allows:
def quota_allows (s : State) (key : String) (tokens : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s.quotas.lookup key with
  | some q => decide (s.used key + tokens ≤ q)
  | none => true
quota_allows_le:
theorem quota_allows_le (s : State) (k : String) (t q : Nat) (ha : quota_allows s k t = true) (h : s.quotas.lookup k = some q) : s.used k + t ≤ q := by
  simp only [quota_allows, h] at ha
  exact of_decide_eq_true ha
record_usage:
def record_usage (s : State) (key : String) (model : String) (tokens : Nat) : Except String (Nat × State) :=
  if input_ok key model tokens then
    if quota_allows s key tokens then
      let s' := { s with calls := s.calls ++ [{ key := key, model := model, tokens := tokens }] }
      .ok (s'.used key, s')
    else .error "quota exceeded for this key"
  else .error "invalid call: key and model must be non-empty and tokens must be a positive whole number"
set_price:
def set_price (s : State) (model : String) (cents : Nat) : Except String (Nat × State) :=
  .ok (cents, { s with prices := (model, cents) :: s.prices.filter (fun p => p.1 != model) })
set_quota:
def set_quota (s : State) (key : String) (tokens : Nat) : Except String (Nat × State) :=
  if s.used key ≤ tokens then
    .ok (tokens, { s with quotas := (key, tokens) :: s.quotas })
  else .error "key has already used more than this quota"
spender_better:
def spender_better (s : State) (k a : String) : Bool :=
  decide (cost s a < cost s k) || (decide (cost s a = cost s k) && decide (k < a))
spender_better_ge:
theorem spender_better_ge (s : State) (k a : String) (h : spender_better s k a = true) : cost s a ≤ cost s k := by
  by_cases hc : cost s a ≤ cost s k
  · exact hc
  · have hlt : cost s k < cost s a := by omega
    have hd1 : decide (cost s a < cost s k) = false := by
      rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      omega
    have hd2 : decide (cost s a = cost s k) = false := by
      rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
      omega
    rw [spender_better, hd1, hd2] at h
    have h' : (false : Bool) = true := by simpa using h
    cases h'
spender_better_le:
theorem spender_better_le (s : State) (k a : String) (h : ¬ spender_better s k a = true) : cost s k ≤ cost s a := by
  by_cases hc : cost s k ≤ cost s a
  · exact hc
  · have hlt : cost s a < cost s k := by omega
    have hd1 : decide (cost s a < cost s k) = true := by
      rw [decide_eq_true_eq]
      exact hlt
    rw [spender_better, hd1] at h
    have h' : ((true : Bool) || (decide (cost s a = cost s k) && decide (k < a))) = true := rfl
    exact absurd h' h
top_spender:
def top_spender (s : State) : Option String :=
  match keys_of s with
  | [] => none
  | k :: ks => some (pick_best s k ks)
usage: def usage (s : State) (key : String) : Nat := s.used key
used_append:
theorem used_append (cs : List Call) (c : Call) (k : String) : State.used { calls := cs ++ [c] } k = State.used { calls := cs } k + (if c.key = k then c.tokens else 0) := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => by_cases h : c.key = k <;> simp [State.used, h]
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.cons_append, used_cons, ih] <;> omega
used_append_other:
theorem used_append_other (cs : List Call) (c : Call) (k : String) (h : ¬ c.key = k) : State.used { calls := cs ++ [c] } k = State.used { calls := cs } k := by
  rw [used_append]
  rw [if_neg h]
  rw [Nat.add_zero]
used_append_same:
theorem used_append_same (cs : List Call) (c : Call) : State.used { calls := cs ++ [c] } c.key = State.used { calls := cs } c.key + c.tokens := by
  rw [used_append]
  rw [if_pos rfl]
used_cons:
theorem used_cons (c : Call) (cs : List Call) (k : String) : State.used { calls := c :: cs } k = (if c.key = k then c.tokens else 0) + State.used { calls := cs } k := by
  by_cases h : c.key = k <;> simp [State.used, h]
